title: One SDK for generation in Node.js and browsers
summary:
A unified SDK replaces the old React package, text model names get less fussy, and account and model-stats pages become clearer.

The team added `@pollinations/sdk` 4.0.1 with image, video, text, chat, audio, and model-list requests through the unified API. It includes streaming, batch and conversation helpers, typed responses, retries, and timeouts. This is a breaking replacement for the old React package; React hooks are not included.

Text-generation validation now accepts registry aliases as well as service IDs. `kimi` replaces `kimi-k2-thinking` as the service ID, while `kimi-k2-thinking` and `kimi-k2` remain aliases; `kimi-reasoning` was added and `kimi-thinking` removed. The gateway also picked up a Gemini token-accounting fix so downstream analytics do not calculate negative visible-token counts.

The legacy auth page removed its login button and now directs people to Enter for accounts and tokens. Its notice says registrations, logins, and token management are disabled there, while anonymous API calls still work.

highlights.title: Unified generation SDK
highlights.text: Use `@pollinations/sdk` for image, video, text, chat, and audio requests from Node.js or the browser, with streaming and batch helpers. It replaces the old React package; React hooks are not included.
